gamemodes.name: Scripted Mode
gamemodes.description: Nothing in this world happens on its own. Every action is a click, issued by your code: write TypeScript in VS Code and play at click speed.
rules: Every action happens instantly when clicked, by a script or by you. Nothing idles.
After each action, the next one waits its normal time divided by your Speed setting (Mod Settings, default 10). Speed bonuses shorten it.
Combat is turn-based: each Attack click, you act and then the enemy acts.
Uses the Standard Mode ruleset, without the tutorial.
